text: I mostly talk things through with my sister Mara. She and my old roommate Theo have known each other for years. At work I lean on Priya, though she has never met Mara or Theo.
When something big comes up I call my dad, Luis. My neighbour Ines checks in on me most weeks; she and my dad play cards together on Sundays.
Honestly it is mostly my partner, Sam. Sam's best friend Dee has become a friend of mine too, and my coach, Ray, knows both of them from the club.
